title: neoregelia cruenta
intro: Neoregelia cruenta, commonly known as the scarlet torch bromeliad, is a species of flowering plant in the bromeliad family. This plant is known for its vibrant red and green foliage and is often used in ornamental arrangements. Neoregelia cruenta has been found to have potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and other compounds that exhibit therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and wound-healing properties.
